name: alltime_party

beats.vo: If our all-time greats were a Pokemon team,
beats.dlg: IF OUR ALL-TIME GREATS|WERE A POKEMON TEAM...

beats.vo: this is the party. And our ace is mythical.
beats.dlg: THIS IS THE PARTY.|AND OUR ACE IS MYTHICAL!

beats.vo: First up. Vince Carter is Rayquaza.
beats.dlg: FIRST UP:|VINCE CARTER!

beats.vo: The Pokedex says it flies so high, no one had ever seen it. Then Vince took off.
beats.dlg: IT FLIES SO HIGH NO ONE|HAD EVER SEEN IT.

beats.vo: Rookie of the Year, then the two thousand dunk contest. Air Canada.
beats.dlg: 1999 ROOKIE OF THE YEAR.|2000 DUNK CHAMP!

beats.vo: Chris Bosh is Amfa-ross.
beats.dlg: CHRIS BOSH!

beats.vo: Its tail is a beacon for the lost. After Vince left, Bosh was ours.
beats.dlg: ITS TAIL IS A BEACON|FOR THE LOST.

beats.vo: Five All-Star games in our jersey.
beats.dlg: 5X ALL-STAR WITH US!

beats.vo: DeMar DeRozan is Arcanine.
beats.dlg: DEMAR DEROZAN!

beats.vo: Admired since the past, and it runs as if on wings.
beats.dlg: ADMIRED SINCE THE PAST.|RUNS AS IF ON WINGS.

beats.vo: Nine seasons, and our all-time leading scorer.
beats.dlg: 9 SEASONS.|OUR ALL-TIME TOP SCORER!

beats.vo: Kyle Lowry is Lucario.
beats.dlg: KYLE LOWRY!

beats.vo: It reads every move before it happens. That's how Lowry drew more charges than anyone in the play-by-play era.
beats.dlg: IT READS EVERY MOVE.|THE CHARGES KING.

beats.vo: Our all-time assists leader, six straight All-Star games, and our first ring.
beats.dlg: 4,277 ASSISTS. 6X ALL-STAR.|OUR FIRST RING!

beats.vo: Pascal Siakam is Spinda.
beats.dlg: PASCAL SIAKAM!

beats.vo: No two Spinda are alike, and its dizzy steps throw defenders off. Hello, spin move.
beats.dlg: NO TWO ARE ALIKE.|ITS STEPS FOOL FOES.

beats.vo: Pick twenty-seven. Then Most Improved and a ring in the same season.
beats.dlg: PICK 27. THEN MOST|IMPROVED AND A RING!

beats.vo: And the ace. Kawhi Leonard is Darkrai.
beats.dlg: AND THE ACE:|KAWHI LEONARD!

beats.vo: A mythical Pokemon that gives its foes nightmares. Just ask Philly.
beats.dlg: IT GIVES FOES NIGHTMARES.|JUST ASK PHILLY.

beats.vo: Four bounces in Game seven. Then Finals MVP, and our first title.
beats.dlg: 4 BOUNCES. GAME 7.|FINALS MVP, 2019!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any gym.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE|INTO ANY GYM.

beats.vo: Who did we leave out?
beats.dlg: WHO DID WE LEAVE OUT?

caption:
IF OUR ALL-TIME GREATS WERE A POKÉMON TEAM 🎮🏀

🐉 Vince Carter = Rayquaza: flies so high nobody had ever seen it. 1999 Rookie of the Year, 2000 dunk contest champ
💡 Chris Bosh = Ampharos: its tail is a beacon for the lost. 5x All-Star with us
🔥 DeMar DeRozan = Arcanine: admired since the past, runs as if on wings. 9 seasons, our all-time leading scorer
🥋 Kyle Lowry = Lucario: reads every move. Most charges drawn in the play-by-play era, 4,277 assists, 6x All-Star, our first ring
🌀 Pascal Siakam = Spinda: no two are alike, and that spin. Pick 27, then Most Improved and a ring in 2019
🌑 Kawhi Leonard = Darkrai, the ace: a mythical that gives foes nightmares. Just ask Philly. 2019 Finals MVP

Who did we leave out? 👇

facts.claim: Carter won the 1999 NBA Rookie of the Year Award; nickname Air Canada; won the 2000 Slam Dunk Contest
With the Raptors, Bosh became a five-time (5x) NBA All-Star and supplanted Vince Carter as the face and leader of the franchise
DeRozan spent nine (9) seasons with the Raptors (2009-2018), where he became the franchise's all-time leading scorer
Lowry: NBA's charges drawn leader for the play-by-play era; Raptors all-time leader in assists (4277); 6x All-Star (six straight, 2015-2020) with Toronto; NBA champion 2019, the Raptors' first title
Raptors career leaders: assists #1 Kyle Lowry 4277
Siakam was drafted 27th overall (#27) by Toronto in 2016; NBA Most Improved Player in 2019, the first to win the award and an NBA title in the same season
Leonard's Game 7 buzzer-beater vs Philadelphia (Philly) bounced four (4) times on the rim before dropping, 92-90, May 12, 2019; 2019 NBA champion and Finals MVP with Toronto, the Raptors' first title
Rayquaza (HeartGold Pokedex): It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
Ampharos (Gold Pokedex): The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
Arcanine (Red Pokedex): A Pokemon that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
Lucario (Pearl Pokedex): By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.
Spinda (Diamond Pokedex): No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
Darkrai is a Mythical Pokemon; (Pearl Pokedex) Folklore has it that on moonless nights, this Pokemon will make people see horrific nightmares.
